big: In 2025 the RBI cut the repo rate from 6.50% to 5.25%. Then came a pause. Then on 7 October 2026, a 25 bps hike to 5.50%, the first in over three years. Why does one policy rate move so many other rates?

lines: Why should I care about the repo rate?
It anchors what banks pay on deposits, what they charge on loans, and the yield on bonds. When it moves, EMIs, FD rates and bond prices follow.
